name: Automated Weekly Executive Business Health Digest

parameters.content:
## 1. DATA AGGREGATION
Every Monday at 6am, pulls this week's numbers from three source categories in parallel: payments (Stripe), ad platforms (Meta + Google Ads), and CRM (HubSpot deals + pipeline). Each branch aggregates its own raw API response into a few clean metrics.

## 2. TREND & FLAG LOGIC
Pulls the trailing 4 weeks of logged metrics and compares this week against that baseline. The headline check: ad spend spiking while conversions drop >15% vs. trailing average gets a highlighted warning flag. Every other metric also gets a week-over-week and vs-4wk-avg delta.

## 3. REPORT GENERATION
Builds a scannable Markdown executive summary, converts it to HTML, then renders that to a PDF.

## 4. DELIVERY
The PDF is stored in Drive and the Markdown digest — with a link to the full PDF — is posted straight to the leadership Slack channel. This week's numbers are also logged so next week's trailing average includes them.

## ERROR HANDLING
Any data-source failure (an ad account token expiring, a CRM API timeout) fires this trigger and pings ops — better than leadership getting a Monday digest with a silently-missing revenue number.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ query: "SELECT metrics.cost_micros, metrics.conversions FROM customer WHERE segments.date DURING LAST_7_DAYS" }) }}

nodes.name: HTTP Request: Google Ads - Weekly Insights

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ filterGroups: [{ filters: [ { propertyName: 'dealstage', operator: 'EQ', value: 'closedwon' }, { propertyName: 'closedate', operator: 'GTE', value: $now.minus({days: 7}).toMillis() } ] }] , properties: ['dealname','amount','closedate'] }) }}

nodes.name: HTTP Request: HubSpot - Deals Won This Week

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ filterGroups: [{ filters: [ { propertyName: 'dealstage', operator: 'NEQ', value: 'closedwon' }, { propertyName: 'dealstage', operator: 'NEQ', value: 'closedlost' } ] }], properties: ['dealname','amount'] }) }}

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ source: $json.data, landscape: false, use_print: false }) }}
